{
  "kind": "academy_item_evidence_contract",
  "contractId": "academy.item-evidence-extension",
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "revision": 1,
  "dataClass": "non_sensitive_contract",
  "authorityGranted": false,
  "defaultView": "lanes",
  "alternativeViews": ["matrix", "tree", "ledger", "icicle"],
  "typescriptContract": "scripts/question-model.ts",
  "viewContractVersion": "1.1.0",
  "storage": {
    "canonicalStructure": "shared_book_edition_registry",
    "selectedStudentEvidence": "student_book_evidence_view",
    "rendering": "disposable_private_projection",
    "spaceIsTransactionalBackend": false,
    "automaticRuntimeIntegration": "not_implemented"
  },
  "entities": ["EditionBinding", "UnitBinding", "SectionBinding", "Item", "ItemVariant", "ItemAttempt", "ItemGrade", "ItemReview", "ItemEvidence", "ItemNotebook"],
  "identityRules": [
    "Keep stable opaque domain IDs, revisions, native identities, original printed labels, and source row IDs separate.",
    "Unknown native ID remains null; sourceAttemptId does not imply a known nativeAttemptId.",
    "Require exact edition, unit, section, item, presented variant, assignment and student scope for a claim."
  ],
  "variantKinds": ["source", "similar", "revised", "reprint"],
  "notebookKinds": ["lecture_notes", "solution_notes"],
  "evidenceKinds": ["source_record", "answer_image", "lecture_note_capture", "solution_note_capture", "grading_annotation"],
  "orderingEdgeMeaning": "verified_printed_or_display_order_not_conceptual_dependency",
  "stateRules": [
    "No real item source means absent questionLayer or empty not_captured collections with null denominator.",
    "Retain every attempt; distinguish retry of the same variant from remediation on another variant.",
    "Keep score, correctness, teacher review, capture, and completion separate.",
    "Append scoped supersession records; keep old records and unresolved conflicts.",
    "Use private versioned image/note references and exact source hashes, not embedded binary or public uploads."
  ],
  "migration": {
    "policy": "additive_preserve_legacy",
    "legacyIdsRekeyed": false,
    "legacySnapshotContract": "1.1.0",
    "frozenSamplesMutable": false
  },
  "implementationClaims": {
    "schemaAndLocalValidation": true,
    "questionDataAlreadyAvailable": false,
    "automaticGrading": false,
    "ocrOrHandwritingAssessment": false,
    "operationalApplicationBackend": false
  }
}
